phase_name: Deploy, Prove Registration and Firing, Record the Residuals

objectives.description: Capture before-state (settings.json, PreToolUse, git status) of consumer repo
Deploy via deploy-headless.sh to consumer repo
Verify registration bare and joined into the single Write|Edit block (not a second block)
Prove idempotence via second deploy, hook count unchanged
Prove deployed hook fires against a real committed evidence file (refuses modify, allows append), file never written
Confirm evidence directory clean afterward; companion gate 0 blocking findings
Record the two residuals + reproduction recipe in the hook's own header; re-deploy to sync; byte-identical confirmed

notes: Observed pre-existing, unrelated foreign work and one unrelated verify-deploy.sh gate failure (runtime-file tracking, specs/books-evidence/.runs.lock + .observations.lock not gitignored) in the consumer repo, confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this task's hook; recorded via issue-record.sh per Observation Duty. All of this task's own Phase 5 acceptance criteria verified independently green.
